title: Practice Sword
summary: Finesse shortsword with 1d4 Bludgeoning and no weapon actions.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 Bludgeoning plus applicable ability modifier, 5 ft melee. Martial, one-handed, Finesse, Light and Dippable. No weapon actions. A qualifying Sneak Attack can deal Bludgeoning with it.
fields.Acquisition: The Hollow training area, Crèche Y’llek infirmary, House of Healing east wing, or Arfur’s Mansion.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
